Home buyer questions

Property FAQs

Helpful answers for people exploring apartments and homes in Visakhapatnam. Listing details can change; confirm important information directly before acting.

What areas does Ram Realty cover?

Listings and property information on this website focus on Madhuravada and nearby Visakhapatnam areas, including Sai Priya Layout, PM Palem, Yendada and Kommadi. Browse current listings or ask Ram Realty about options.

What property types are listed?

The website features selected residential apartment listings, including 3 BHK homes. Layouts and availability vary by project and unit. Check each property page and confirm current options directly.

Are prices and availability guaranteed to be current?

No. Prices, unit availability and project status may change. Before deciding, confirm the exact unit, current price, additional charges and complete written cost sheet with the relevant property contact.

How do I request more information or a site visit?

Use the enquiry form on a property page, call +91 77992 51808, or message Ram Realty on WhatsApp. Ask to confirm current details and arrange a conversation or visit.

What should I verify before booking?

Review official project and title documents, approvals and applicable RERA details independently. Confirm the selected unit, area calculation, possession terms, inclusions, taxes, other charges and payment terms in writing with the relevant parties.

Does submitting an enquiry commit me to buying?

No. Submitting an enquiry requests information and does not itself create a booking or purchase commitment. See our privacy notice for how enquiry details are handled.

Which area figure should I use when comparing flats?

Check whether each figure is carpet area, built-up area or total saleable area before comparing prices. Common and parking areas can be included separately in project records. Ask for the exact flat number, its area breakdown and the chargeable area in the written cost sheet; the figures published here are not all on the same basis.

Does the per-square-foot rate include every charge?

The listed rates are not stated to be all-inclusive. Depending on the listing, the published details identify amenities, maintenance or other fees, and some charges remain unknown. Request a current written cost sheet for the selected unit showing the base price, applicable taxes and fees, payment terms and any charges not included in the quote.

See the listing comparison and the Maple Woods area qualification for examples from the published collection.
